calm: Speak calmly and naturally, like a founder talking to camera about something they built. Conversational, unhurried, not like an announcer.

male.name: Designed: warm American male, late 20s
male.design: A warm, relaxed American male voice in his late twenties. Natural, conversational and friendly, like talking to a friend about an app he built. Medium pace, clear, not like a radio announcer.

male.name: Designed: low, understated American male, 30s
male.design: A slightly low, calm American male voice in his thirties. Understated and confident, gentle and intimate, close to the microphone. Unhurried pace with natural pauses.

female.name: Designed: warm American female, late 20s
female.design: A warm, friendly American female voice in her late twenties. Natural and conversational, like telling a friend about a travel app. Medium pace, clear, not like a commercial.

female.name: Designed: calm, low American female, 30s
female.design: A calm, slightly low American female voice in her thirties. Relaxed and confident, close to the microphone, unhurried with natural pauses.

female.name: Designed: bright American female, early 20s
female.design: A bright, upbeat young American female voice in her early twenties, casual and natural like a creator on social media. Lively but not exaggerated.
